services.name: Tumbling
services.desc: Level 1 is for students in the beginning stages of tumbling. They will learn basic tumbling skills on trampoline, tumble track, rod floor and floor. Tumbling skills taught include beginning progressions for cartwheels, roundoffs, back handsprings. The Tumbling Level 2 program is for students that are in the intermediate stages of tumbling. They will continue to learn new skills on trampoline, tumble track,and spring floor. Skills taught include intermediate progressions for cartwheels, roundoffs, back handsprings. The Tumbling Level 3 program is for students that are in the advanced stages of tumbling and have mastered the round off on floor and back handspring on trampoline.
